name: Harvest
overview: Scripture reveals that harvest is a divinely ordained season marked by both physical and spiritual significance, as seen in the established rhythm of seedtime and harvest that will continue as long as the earth endures (Genesis 8:22). The agricultural cycle includes specific crops such as barley and wheat, with barley ripening before wheat (Exodus 9:31-32) and distinct feasts like the Feast of Weeks celebrating the firstfruits of the wheat harvest (Exodus 34:22). God commands rest even during earing and harvest times (Exodus 34:21), underscoring the sacred nature of these seasons as times for rejoicing and acknowledging His provision (Exodus 23:16).
